exposure.needed: whether cert-manager is installed and upgraded through an OperatorHub/OLM package (RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub or operatorhub.io) rather than Helm or static manifests

consequence.statement: No cert-manager releases after v1.16.5 are published to OperatorHub (RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub or operatorhub.io). Installs managed through OperatorHub/OLM stay on v1.16.5 and get no newer versions from that source. The evidence does not say that the existing install fails.
consequence.remediation: If you install cert-manager from OperatorHub/OLM and need versions after v1.16.5, plan to move to another distribution method. The cert-manager-olm repository is archived.

assertion.statement: OperatorHub Packages Discontinued: We no longer publish OperatorHub packages for cert-manager

evidence.excerpt:
### OperatorHub Packages Discontinued

We no longer publish OperatorHub packages for cert-manager.
Why? Because the cert-manager maintainers no longer have the time or resources to maintain and test those packages.
cert-manager `v1.16.5` is the last release on OperatorHub.
